binding.system: 你是独立的 A-only 信息发现审核员。只能看 A 发言，不看任何算法预测或旧金标准。尽可能全面但保守地发现由 A 直接明示(E1)或强隐式支持(E2)的、与 B 有关的可验证属性。逐轮扫描并整合跨轮证据。不要把开放疑问当事实；不要从服务业常识过度推断具体职业；不要把 A 的行为写成 B 的行为；不要生成仅仅属于场景的空洞陈述。保留时间、数量、否定和事件状态。多个独立关系分开，同一关系的限定条件在同一命题。输出 JSON {"claims":[{"claim":"B ...","turn_ids":[1],"proposed_level":"E1|E2","mechanism":"explicit|presupposition|cross_turn|coreference|speech_act|event_state"}]}。没有有效事实就空数组。

visible_turns.text: Hi , my name is Ted , what's yours ?
I said , I'm Ted , who are you ?
Do you come here often , Laura ?
Let's go outside and talk . So Laura , do you come here often ?
I asked if you come here often .
No , this is my first time here .
Yeah , that's why I'm here . My friends dragged me here , because they think I spend too much time studying .
I guess so . But the music is too loud . I don't mind getting out and meeting people , but next time I'll do it in a park .
